instruction:
Model Audit -> JSON Report

The file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\audit_me.dae` contains a COLLADA scene whose structure you must introspect. It contains multiple geometry definitions (`<geometry>` elements in `library_geometries`), some of which are instanced in the visual scene via `<node>` + `<instance_geometry>`, and some of which exist in the library but are never referenced by any scene node (these are "orphan" definitions - the COLLADA analogue of SketchUp component definitions that live in the In Model component browser but are not placed anywhere in the scene).

Produce a JSON report describing the scene's audit signature with exactly this schema:

```
{
"n_geometry_defs": <int>, // total count of <geometry> in library
"n_geometry_defs_instanced": <int>, // defs referenced by >=1 scene node
"total_instances": <int>, // total scene <node> count that carries an <instance_geometry>
"instances_per_def": {<name>: <count>,...}, // include every def, 0 if unused
"faces_per_def": {<name>: <face_count>,...},
"orphan_defs": [<name>,...] // defs with 0 instances
}
```

Definition "name" is the `name` attribute on the `<geometry>` element (fall back to the `id` attribute if `name` is missing). Face count means the number of triangles in the primitive set(s) of that geometry.

Save the report to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.json`.

Requirements:
1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.json` parses as valid JSON.
2. All 6 required top-level keys are present.
3. `n_geometry_defs`, `n_geometry_defs_instanced`, `total_instances` match the init file exactly.
4. `instances_per_def` includes every geometry definition (including orphans, with count 0) and matches expected counts.
5. `faces_per_def` matches the triangle counts of the geometries.
6. `orphan_defs` is a list (order-insensitive) of every geometry with zero instances.
source: SU-Ruby Entities iteration + `ComponentDefinition.instances`; Foltz-Ruby audit patterns; COLLADA 1.5 library_geometries

command: if exist "C:\Program Files\SketchUp\SketchUp 2026\SketchUp\SketchUp.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
